answer: An attacker needs one bonded stake per sybil plus sustained epoch participation, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand real stakes, making mass deception economically irrational. At each dawn, participants must burn a small bonded stake to claim a rotating beacon slot that anchors reputation slot to a verifiable on-chain history; duplicate identities are pruned like footprints erased on a dune. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
